title: Realigning the Monthly Due Day on an Auto Loan
content:
Where the due day on a loan of the Auto Loans line is realigned, the loan's due day and its next installment date are rewritten, and the date of the change is recorded on the loan.

**A due day is moved only once no standing instruction to draft the installment from a deposit account remains on the loan.** While the loan's record still carries such an instruction, or an account recorded as the one the installment is drafted from, the due day stands where it is.

## The capability

The servicing desk's tool `change_payment_due_day_9dcc583e` moves the day of the month an auto loan installment falls due to a new day. The loan's due day is rewritten to the day passed in, the loan's next installment date is rewritten to the date passed in, and today's date is recorded on the loan as the date of its most recent due day change, which is what the once-per-window record is read from afterwards. The borrower sees the new due day and the new next installment date on the loan record; the maturity date and the installment amount are untouched.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden. The agent unlocks `change_payment_due_day_9dcc583e` and then calls it; the agent performs the move themselves rather than handing it to the borrower.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the auto loan whose due day is being moved, read from the loan record returned by the auto loan lookup before the call | Id |
| `realigned_due_day` | The day of the month the installment is to fall due on from now on | An integer from 1 to 28, with no leading zero and no other punctuation |
| `next_installment_due_date` | The date the next installment falls due once the day has moved | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the loan reference number, the day of the month the installment now falls due on, the date of the next installment, and the date the change was recorded. Receiving that sentence means the loan record carries the new due day.
